<thought>Use a minimal valid CIF for bulk silicon (diamond structure) and call the enumerate_slabs_text tool to generate all (111) slab terminations. Then write the resulting JSON to a file and return its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>

  "bulk_cif": "data_Si
_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M   'Fd-3m'

_cell_length_b   5.431
_cell_length_c   5.431
_cell_angle_alpha   90
_cell_angle_beta    90
_cell_angle_gamma   90
_chemical_formula_sum   'Si1'
loop_
 _atom_site_label
 _atom_site_type_symbol

}"}
